answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable deposit and complete verified useful tasks that peers check before it earns any weight. A fake identity cannot be cloned for free: creating thousands means locking thousands of deposits and doing thousands of distinct, checked tasks, while any identity caught copying or cheating loses its deposit. Like a cedar growing slowly through shifting dune sand toward a distant ocean, weight accrues only over time and verified work, so a Sybil flood arrives too late, too expensively, and without influence.
